newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tongkah, Otto form joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Tongkah, Otto form joint venture.

text.p: Malaysia's Tongkah Holdings Bhd on Wednesday entered into a 35 million ringgit joint venture with Otto Group of Germany to manufacture and manage solid waste disposal systems in Malaysia.
Tongkah will hold a 51 percent stake in the joint venture company, Tongkah-Otto (M) Sdn Bhd, while Otto will hold 49 percent.

Tongkah Executive Chairman Mokhani Mahathir told reporters after the signing that production will begin in May with initial capacity of 190,000 bins per year. He said the plant will produce two and four wheeled mobile garbage bins, followed by environmental engineering hardware in the coming months.
Otto director of international export, Lucien Rosler said the plant would be the provider for products, technology and experienced personnel to spearhead the growing market in Asia.
